description: Defines a custom exception class 'PublicKeyProviderUnavailableException' used in the security/authentication JWT module of the Eclipse Ditto project. The class includes methods for creating instances, including from JSON, and a builder class for constructing instances.

classes.name: PublicKeyProviderUnavailableException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating the public key provider is unavailable, extends DittoRuntimeException, implements GatewayException.

classes.name: PublicKeyProviderUnavailableException.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing instances of PublicKeyProviderUnavailableException with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for PublicKeyProviderUnavailableException.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
